verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented training opt-out, no no-training guarantee, and no data-retention control for ByteAsk. One probe notes that a 'data-handling policy' exists in llms.txt but gives none of its content. Self-hosted or BYO-key model support is an adjacent workaround that routes inference elsewhere, not a first-party control that prevents training on user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
